_comment: Backlog proxy-gate fixtures derived from the full-catalog stress run (2026-06-12). Each fixture is one representative case for a backlog class. converterClass is the coarse class spt's converter emits TODAY (asserted by TestBacklogProxyGate). refinedClass is what replayqual.py re-buckets it into for reporting. disposition=lock => by-design unsupported, converterClass must never change. disposition=fix => P1 target; when implemented, set converterClass to "" (expect success) and add positive assertions. harnessExcerptSubstrings are the lowercased tokens the private replayqual.py classifier keys on to produce refinedClass; the test asserts the converter error still contains them so a converter message change that would silently break the out-of-repo harness fails here instead. See cli/mike/planning/REPLAY_BACKLOG_WORK_CONTRACT.md.
